## Description

Formulates portfolio optimization with Entropic Value-at-Risk (EVaR) constraints into Quadratic Unconstrained Binary Optimization (QUBO) problems solved via quantum annealers.

## Where it may fit

Fat-tailed return distributions, high-stress tail risk optimization, institutional risk-averse mandates.

## Vehicles

Institutional Quantitative Funds, Tail-Risk Hedge Funds.

## Required data

Historical asset return panels, EVaR confidence level parameters, risk budget constraints.

## Caveats

NISQ hardware qubit embedding requires graph decomposition heuristics for large asset universes.
